blueprint_concepts: Tangent and normal to a circle
tangents drawn from an external point to a circle

concept_use.Tangent and normal to a circle: Tangent and normal to a circle: the chord of contact is a tangent of C2 when its distance from (2,1) equals 2.
concept_use.tangents drawn from an external point to: Tangents drawn from an external point: P must lie outside C1 (checked, h^2 + k^2 = 25/4 > 4) for the tangents to exist.
concept_use.Chord of contact for Circle: Chord of contact of P(h,k) with respect to C1: hx + ky = 4.

english: Let $C_{1}:x^{2}+y^{2}=4$ and $C_{2}:(x-2)^{2}+(y-1)^{2}=4$. Let $S$ be the set of all points $P$ on the line $2x+y+1=0$ such that $P$ lies outside $C_{1}$ and the chord of contact of the tangents drawn from $P$ to $C_{1}$ touches $C_{2}$. Then the sum of the abscissae of all the points of $S$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $C_{1}:x^{2}+y^{2}=4$ तथा $C_{2}:(x-2)^{2}+(y-1)^{2}=4$ हैं। माना $S$ रेखा $2x+y+1=0$ पर स्थित उन सभी बिन्दुओं $P$ का समुच्चय है जिनके लिए $P$, $C_{1}$ के बाहर स्थित है तथा $P$ से $C_{1}$ पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाओं की स्पर्श जीवा $C_{2}$ को स्पर्श करती है। तब $S$ के सभी बिन्दुओं के भुजों का योग ______ है।
solution: Both points are outside $C_{1}$: $h^{2}+(2h+1)^{2}=\dfrac{25}{4}>4$ in each case
solution_full: A point of the line is $P=(h,k)$ with $k=-2h-1$.
For $P$ outside $C_{1}$ the chord of contact is $T=0$: $hx+ky=4$.
$C_{2}$ has centre $(2,1)$ and radius $2$. The chord of contact touches $C_{2}$ when its distance from $(2,1)$ is $2$: $\dfrac{|2h+k-4|}{\sqrt{h^{2}+k^{2}}}=2$.
Points: $\left(\dfrac{7}{10},-\dfrac{12}{5}\right)$ and $\left(-\dfrac{3}{2},2\right)$. For both, $h^{2}+k^{2}=5h^{2}+4h+1=\dfrac{25}{4}>4$, so both lie outside $C_{1}$ and the tangents exist.
originality_note: New: points on a line whose chord of contact with respect to one circle is tangent to a second, intersecting circle; the distance condition simplifies because 2h + k - 4 is constant on the line (way 4, a hidden constant). Closest known: chord of contact of points on a line passes through a fixed point; chord of contact touching a concentric circle (locus is a circle). Different because: the second circle is not concentric, so the condition is a genuine quadratic in h whose numerator happens to be constant, and the outside-check matters.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, curve and parameter is introduced, the conditions are complete, there is one reading, the answer is unique and equals the Answer Plan, and the Hindi mirrors the English. Checked that the set S has exactly two points and both are outside C1, so the sum is well defined. Answer -0.8 is a negative decimal as planned. No change.
key_step: Write the chord of contact hx + ky = 4 and impose tangency to C2, noticing 2h + k - 4 = -5 on the line.
justification: Chord of contact, tangency distance and a quadratic, plus the existence check; three linked steps without options. Comparable to 2021-P1-Q1 (L3).
